hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM as a Uniswap v4 hook, routing swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts via a custom bonding curve, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing standard concentrated liquidity entirely.
